limitations: C0D4-MOB1 adds read-only movement and button-owner context; action acceptance remains unknown without gameplay-owner acknowledgement. C0D4-OBS1 appends Grave I, Grave II, Host effect/outcome, and Silt-return observations to REC1 without new gameplay. Events between 150ms polls or pruned from a producer ring may be missed. Owner state is retained across mounts, not browser reloads. No physical material transfer or off-route simulation is implied.

captureRetention.caveat: Full recorder history does not guarantee source truth if a producer 64-entry ring overflows between 150ms samples.

hostConnections.proofLimit: Verified Silt release creates provenance only. LS1E2 Vascular consumes signal receipts into its own bounded membrane state and directional current; no grain arrival, chemistry transfer or progression credit.

siltTrajectoryField.proofLimit: Silt route-local geometry labels only; between includes corridors, outside cavities and distant positions. No cross-region or off-route physics claim.

siltTrajectory.proofLimit: Route-local world-position and velocity continuity for released unseated grain; LS1B remains native phase authority. No collision impulse, scene-wide ecology, save persistence, mass change or off-route simulation.

siltPlateSeat.proofLimit: One route-local receiving site; environment remains ledger owner. No global persistent save or native-path motion rewrite.

siltContact.proofLimit: Contact is authored-patch proximity and bounded Stabilize brace; D2M prioritizes an already-touching brace before Pulse and reports tether tension. Imprint is reversible visual/pressure state, not collisions, force, fracture, or chemical bond.

summary.proofLimit: D2H held-material receipts report bounded positional displacement accepted by the Silt grip; these are not physics impulse, chemistry consumption, or material-ownership transfer proofs. Environmental Silt route and other gameplay subsystems remain separate.
